required.purpose: CPU field backend and scientific prediction

optional.purpose: PNG and GIF previews; runtime degrades safely when absent

optional.install_requirement: CuPy package matching the installed CUDA toolkit

runtime_policy.temporary_files: Python tempfile and TMPDIR; no fixed temporary-directory path
runtime_policy.desktop_display: X11 or Wayland is required for interactive GUI routes; headless validation routes do not require a display
runtime_policy.desktop_path_opening: xdg-open is optional and affects convenience actions only
runtime_policy.shell_execution: argv subprocess execution only; shell=True is forbidden
